name: Nicotiny
look: a tiny green seedling bud with dewdrop eyes, two broad sticky dew-glistening leaves and a sprout, on root feet
entry: Farmers once planted Nicotiny around their gardens to keep Caterpie away, though touching its leaves gives trainers a sudden dizzy spell.
how: Wild: common in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
Its ability Pest Deterrent lowers the Attack of Bug-type foes when it switches in.
